name: Alabama public works bid triage

product.purpose: Prepare a weekly, source-linked public-works notice digest for general contractors working in Mobile and Baldwin Counties from official notices the contractor forwards, official exports they supply, or links they choose.
product.pilot_scope: General contracting; Mobile and Baldwin Counties; one weekly digest. Scope is a test hypothesis, not evidence of demand.
product.publication: Local draft only. The owner reviews and sends any customer email; contractors verify controlling notices and submit their own bids.
product.billing: One 30-day paid pilot at a test price of $49; no billing or payment collection is automated.

your_steps.title: Send the pilot pitch
your_steps.when: When you are ready to test buyer interest
your_steps.detail: Review PILOT.md and prospects.csv, then personally send the pitch to appropriate businesses using only their published business contact details. Glacier does not send messages, sign anyone up, or collect payment.

launch_gates: Use only official notice emails, official downloadable exports supplied by the customer, or links the customer supplies; do not automate browsing or scraping Alabama Builds.
Every digest is labeled incomplete and links to the issuing authority's controlling notice.
Each contractor controls its own registration, vendor profile, credentials, eligibility decisions, and bid submission.
